operational_goals.title: Index all DAW sessions
operational_goals.description: Run daw-project-scan across all session directories to build a complete project index. Every session should be cataloged with DAW type, track count, last modified date, and BPM.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All DAW projects discovered, indexed in session catalog, and browsable via navig commands.

operational_goals.title: Establish daily studio routine
operational_goals.description: Configure the morning-studio workflow to run automatically each morning. This checks for unfinished sessions, overdue releases, and inbox items.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Workflow runs on schedule, produces a daily brief, flags blocked items.

operational_goals.title: Catalog sample library
operational_goals.description: Run sample-catalog across all sample directories to build a searchable index. Samples should be tagged with BPM, key, type, and genre.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All samples indexed, searchable by BPM/key/type, duplicates flagged.

operational_goals.title: Define release pipeline
operational_goals.description: Configure the release-cycle workflow with distributor-specific requirements. Set up metadata templates and format profiles for each platform.
operational_goals.success_criteria: One-command release prep that produces platform-compliant packages with correct metadata.

operational_goals.title: Loudness compliance templates
operational_goals.description: Create loudness-check presets for streaming (-14 LUFS), broadcast (-23 LUFS), and club (-6 LUFS) targets.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All masters pass loudness check against target standard before release.
